answer: Gradual task quotas grow slowly. New identities start with 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2 slots. The cap is 40 slots. Idle 3 epochs and the quota falls 4. Cheating resets the quota to 2. Rewards freeze for 6 epochs. Repeat cheating doubles the climb. The dawn of a new identity is small. The terrace rises one step at a time. A forger with 1,000 identities needs 19 epochs of real work to reach high quotas. That costs 152,000 units. The grove grows slowly by design. Fake identities stay small. Real work climbs. Forgery pays for patience it does not have.
